description: List past resume generations, newest first. Use limit and offset to paginate through results (e.g., offset=20 returns the second page of 20). Returns resumes array with total count, limit, and offset.

limit.description: Max number of resumes to return. Default: 20.

offset.description: Number of resumes to skip for pagination. Default: 0.

name: klevercv_list_resumes
